about: Steel casement modelled as a product: angle frame, mullion and transom, two casement sashes with glass and glazing bars (outside the frame line, +y), fanlight sash with glass, room-side aluminium mesh screen with mesh and mid bar, vertical burglar bars with two flats, restrictor stays and cockspur handles, quartz window board inside, sloped precast cill outside. Geometry drawn at the first type's size; brand, model and supplier open for review.
